_comment: When specific menu items are served, loaded by npm run import:menu into meals.serving_windows and menu_combos.serving_windows. Same per-day format as dining_hours.json (America/Los_Angeles, all seven days, [] = not served that day), or "unknown". Items with no matching rule are served whenever the location is open. An item is available only when its location is open AND its window is open. Precedence: overrides (by source_id) > rules.
